metadata.description: Plugins for the Neuralscape memory layer — works with Claude Code and Claude Cowork.

plugins.name: neuralscape
plugins.description: Persistent agentic memory for Claude (Code + Cowork). In Claude Code, hooks auto-capture conversations and recall context on session start; in Cowork (no plugin hooks), the cross-platform skills (recall/remember/save-session/project/ingest) drive memory via the bundled OAuth MCP connector. The ingest skill loads files/folders/pasted context (Markdown/HTML/PDF/MS-Office). Exposes 10 MCP tools.
